integrity: Analytic proof with exact symbolic Lyapunov verification and independent-audit status explicitly not_performed; no claim of formal certification or experimental generality.
scientific_limitations: Scalar curvature-matched heavy ball, state-independent additive AR(1) noise, finite nonzero innovation variance, stationary last-iterate risk. No multi-dimensional or other step-size extrapolation. Global minimizer existence and sign established but finite-q uniqueness is not asserted. Classical ARMA optimization precedence remains a residual risk.
title: Sign-reversed optimal momentum and the one-ninth antipersistent noise floor
